limitations: Structural XML parity does not establish native/browser numerical equivalence or successful benchmark execution.
Image hashes, resolution and sampling establish provenance; perceived realism still requires visual review.
Dimensions, hidden construction and material parameters remain estimates unless independently calibrated.
Flexible details use visual deformation; cable contact, strain and fluid dynamics are not simulated.
